$comment: SPEC v0.4.8 row 3: show.resync's `viewItemEnd`, the on-air timed item's end re-established
on a restarted engine. Read by BOTH readers: nbe-protocol's mirror (ResyncViewItemEnd, which
the engine reads) and the control plane's protocol.test.ts (ResyncViewItemEndSchema, which
the control plane parses its own snapshot's end through before sending). `valid` must read on
both sides and round-trip in Rust; `invalid` must be refused by both. remainingFrames is the
item's own duration less the time since the take, rounded up and clamped at zero: zero ends

valid.name: a timed item with time left
the clamped zero: the duration elapsed during the outage

invalid.name: a negative remaining time (an unclamped overdue item)
a remaining time that is not a number
